verdicts.reason: I can't see any difference between A and B, so they share the same flaws. The badge pills are blown up to near-CTA size and placed in a random left/right zigzag, so they compete with the RSVP button. 'Saturday 21 June' is centred but the time line under it is left-aligned and squeezed against the left edge. The partner logo placeholder is cut off on the right ('missing asse', 'partner ma') and crammed under the URL, and the can floats in a dead gap while the top half is packed tight.
